_comment: live_compact tuning. A context engine is constructed with no args and never receives config.yaml, so this file is the only knob surface. LC_* environment variables override it for experiment runs. The two ratios are relative to the MODEL WINDOW and take precedence over the absolute values whenever the window is known (1M -> watermark 20000 / keep 32000; 200k -> 4000 / 6400). The watermark is independent of the keep window.
